mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 238.0 (approximately 3% annualized inflation) signals persistent inflation that erodes real equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising unemployment (UNRATE > 0.2pp monthly) and falling industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicate an economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month AND INDPRO falls > 0.5 in 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC between the interaction of UNRATE and INDPRO and 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to higher discount rates.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 1.0% and remains above 1.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1,200,000 units (HOUST > 1200.0) signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 200.0) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE drop > 0.3pp) indicates a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200.0 AND UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC between the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE and 5-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL rising > 0.5% monthly for 3 months) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as central banks tighten policy.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 60-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window during inflation acceleration periods.
